meta.title: Geekson Software — Freelance full-stack developer in Belgium
meta.description: Custom websites, web and mobile apps for small businesses. Project-based, with a single point of contact: Olivier, full-stack engineer with over 10 years of experience.

hero.title: Custom web tools for small businesses.
hero.intro: Websites, web and mobile apps, designed and delivered end to end by Olivier, an engineer with over 10 years of experience. I work on a project basis: a clear goal, a delivered result.

services.title: What I can build for you
services.aside: Your request doesn't fit any box? Write to me anyway, we'll find a way.

items.title: Business website
items.description: A fast, clear website that explains what you do, reassures your visitors and gets them to reach out.

items.title: Web application
items.description: No more scattered Excel files: your data in one place and simpler processes, in a tool designed around your trade.

items.title: Mobile app
items.description: Your idea in your customers' pockets, on iOS and Android, from mockup to store release.

items.title: Hosting & maintenance
items.description: Databases, APIs, servers: I take care of the infrastructure so you can focus on your business.

items.title: IT consulting
items.description: An experienced look at your architecture or technology choices, before you invest.

work.title: A whole ecosystem for La Brassicole

featured.name: Appicole
featured.description: The app of La Brassicole, a yearly event dedicated to craft beer. Attendees browse the beer list, rate and save their favourites, follow tasting routes and collect badges from one edition to the next.
featured.imageAlt: Two screens of the Appicole app: earned badges and the countdown to the next edition

ecosystem.name: Appicole
ecosystem.description: The mobile app that comes with every edition.

ecosystem.name: Brassicole Order
ecosystem.description: The web app for taking orders on site.

ecosystem.name: Brassicole Stats
ecosystem.description: The real-time dashboard: leaderboard, key figures, charts.

work.note: Three tools, one database: everything stays in sync, from orders to the leaderboard.

about.title: Hi, I'm Olivier.
paragraphs: Full-stack engineer, tech enthusiast, husband and dad. Over 10 years in software have taken me through every stage: design, story mapping, development, delivery and customer support.
I love learning new technologies, and no challenge scares me.

method.title: Projects, not staffing
method.intro: I'm not a developer you hire to sit in your team. Together we define a goal, a scope and a schedule, and I deliver a result.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: A call or a coffee to understand your needs and constraints.

steps.title: I propose
steps.description: A written scope, a schedule and a quote. You know what to expect.

steps.title: I build
steps.description: Regular demos: you see the project move forward and steer it.

steps.title: We launch
steps.description: Go-live, handover, then follow-up and maintenance if you wish.

contact.title: Got a project in mind?
contact.intro: Tell me all about it. I reply within 1 to 2 business days.
